finding.headline: "The Parkrun Mum"
finding.problem: "The NHS says 'gradually' but gives no plan. The APTA pdf needs a physio. I just want the week-by-week walk-to-run that won't prolapse me."
finding.person: Sade, 30, UK-Nigerian, was a parkrun regular; 4 months PP, cleared by GP, wants a graded return-to-run plan that respects DR + pelvic floor.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product (return-to-run protocol — validated by BJSM/APTA gap)". Verdict: PASSES.
